brand.name: AGRO VISION
brand.tagline: Smart Farming. Better Markets. Better Returns.

hero.headline: From Better Insights to Better Returns.
hero.subtext: Connecting farmers, FPOs, and verified buyers through intelligent market information, AI-powered quality assessment, and transparent transactions.

problems.title: The Agricultural Market Challenge
problems.subtitle: Why traditional farm-gate marketing reduces farmer net returns
problems.p1_desc: Farmers lack real-time mandi rate visibility, selling blindly at distress prices to local middlemen.
problems.p2_desc: Small landholdings result in tiny produce volumes, depriving individual farmers of institutional pricing power.
problems.p3_desc: Subjective manual grading at mandis leads to unfair price deductions and frequent disputes.
problems.p4_desc: Poor post-harvest logistics and high cold storage costs erode up to 25% of the final sale value.

solution.title: A Transparent, Aggregation-First Workflow
solution.subtitle: Farmers never deal with buyers directly. FPOs aggregate, standardize, and trade with verified institutional buyers.
solution.farmer_desc: Inputs crop, expected quantity, and photos. Receives AI quality assessment and price predictions.
solution.fpo_desc: Aggregates farmer produce into certified trade lots, verifies quality, and negotiates with verified buyers.
solution.buyer_desc: Posts procurement demands, matches certified FPO lots, negotiates transparent contracts, and deposits escrow.

howItWorks.title: How AGRO VISION Works
howItWorks.subtitle: A structured 5-step transaction lifecycle engineered for maximum net farmer returns
howItWorks.step1_desc: Farmer enters crop, expected quantity, harvest date, location, and photos inside the portal.
howItWorks.step2_desc: The assigned FPO reviews incoming produce, physically verifies quality, and builds standardized trade lots.
howItWorks.step3_desc: System provides ML price predictions, seasonal trends, and calculates true Net Realisation.
howItWorks.step4_desc: Matching engine pairs aggregated FPO lots with verified institutional buyer procurement requirements.
howItWorks.step5_desc: FPO and buyer finalize bilateral contract with secured escrow, tracked transit, and automated farmer payouts.

marketIntel.title: Market Intelligence & ML Price Predictor
marketIntel.subtitle: Real-time Pune district APMC price discovery and machine learning forecast models

aiQuality.title: AI Produce Quality Assessment
aiQuality.subtitle: Computer vision assessment analyzing size, color, surface defects, and rot indicators
aiQuality.uploadPrompt: Upload or select produce photo for AI inspection
aiQuality.disclaimer: Notice: AI grading is a preliminary assessment. Physical inspection by your assigned FPO is required prior to lot aggregation.

trust.title: Trust & Verification Architecture
trust.subtitle: Every FPO and Buyer maintains an algorithmic Trust Score (0-100) based on verified transactions

footer.desc: Empowering Indian agriculture through transparent FPO aggregation, AI-driven quality grading, and predictive market intelligence.
